import ast, hashlib, os, pathlib, shutil, stat, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def snapshot():
    result = {}
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        rel = str(p.relative_to(root))
        if p.is_symlink():
            result[rel] = ('link', stat.S_IMODE(p.lstat().st_mode), os.readlink(p))
        elif p.is_file():
            result[rel] = ('file', stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode), hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        elif p.is_dir():
            result[rel] = ('dir', stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))
    return result
before = snapshot()
original = (root / 'build_plan.py').read_text()
variants = {
    'correct': original,
    'reverse': original.replace('    return order\n', '    return order[::-1]\n'),
    'clear_lists': original.replace('    ready =', '    for parents in dependencies.values():\n        parents.clear()\n    ready =', 1),
    'partial_cycle': original.replace('        raise ValueError("dependency cycle")', '        return order'),
}
base_ast = ast.parse(original)
assert len(base_ast.body) == 1 and base_ast.body[0].name == 'plan'
work = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.audit-', dir=root))
try:
    for variant, source in variants.items():
        copy = work / variant
        copy.mkdir()
        for name in ('AGENTS.md', 'CONTRACT.md', 'build_plan.py', 'test_plan.py'):
            shutil.copy2(root / name, copy / name)
        (copy / 'build_plan.py').write_text(source)
        assert (copy / 'test_plan.py').read_bytes() == (root / 'test_plan.py').read_bytes()
        assert len(ast.parse(source).body) == 1 and ast.parse(source).body[0].name == 'plan'
        check = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-c', 'import build_plan, test_plan; assert test_plan.plan is build_plan.plan; print("BOUND IMPLEMENTATION:", test_plan.plan.__code__.co_filename)'], cwd=copy, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print('\nVARIANT:', variant, flush=True)
        print(check.stdout, end='')
        assert check.returncode == 0, check.stderr
        for selector in ('test_plan.PlanTests.test_chain', 'test_plan.PlanTests.test_cycle'):
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONVERBOSE='1')
            command = ['python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', selector, '-v']
            run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=copy, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
            lines = run.stderr.splitlines()
            evidence = [s for s in lines if str(copy / 'build_plan.py') in s or str(copy / 'test_plan.py') in s]
            assert any(str(copy / 'build_plan.py') in s for s in evidence), run.stderr
            print('CWD:', copy)
            print('COMMAND:', ' '.join(command))
            print('IMPORT EVIDENCE:', '\n'.join(evidence))
            start = next(i for i,s in enumerate(lines) if s.startswith(selector.split('.')[-1] + ' ('))
            end = next(i for i in range(start, len(lines)) if lines[i] == 'OK' or lines[i].startswith('FAILED ('))
            print('\n'.join(lines[start:end+1]))
            print('EXIT:', run.returncode, flush=True)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(work)
after = snapshot()
assert before == after, 'Original tree changed'
print('\nPRESERVATION: all original bytes and modes unchanged; disposable copies removed; no added files.')
